summary: WhatsApp Image Accumulation feature testing completed. All 12 backend tests passed (100%). The fix using MongoDB $push with $each for atomic image accumulation is working correctly. Multiple images are properly accumulated to pending_images, and 'listo' command correctly processes all images to proof_images.
critical_code_review_comments: The fix is correctly implemented - $push with $each ensures atomic operations preventing race conditions where only the first image was assigned.
The whatsapp_active flag query correctly prioritizes active withdrawals over fallback to oldest pending.
Consider adding try-catch around Twilio send operations in the webhook to prevent failures from affecting the overall flow (currently if Twilio fails, the transaction processing might fail too).
seed_data_creation: Test withdrawals created with TEST_ prefix during tests, cleaned up after test session
context_for_next_testing_agent: WhatsApp image accumulation flow fully tested. Key tests: (1) $push $each atomic operation works correctly, (2) whatsapp_active flag query finds correct active withdrawal, (3) fallback to oldest pending withdrawal works, (4) concurrent image additions are preserved, (5) 'listo' command moves pending_images to proof_images and marks completed. Twilio webhook endpoint exists and handles requests but actual Twilio message sending is mocked (test returns 400 for invalid test phone).

image_accumulation_with_push_each.description: MongoDB $push with $each for atomic image addition

fallback_to_oldest.description: Falls back to oldest pending withdrawal if no active

concurrent_image_handling.description: Multiple concurrent image additions are preserved

full_accumulation_flow.description: First image -> Second image -> Third image -> 'listo' -> proof_images with all 3

tests_performed.test: 'listo' with no pending images returns appropriate response
Process command moves images to proof_images
whatsapp_active flag query finds correct withdrawal

mocked_api_note: Twilio message sending is MOCKED - the webhook endpoint works and processes correctly, but actual SMS/WhatsApp messages are not sent (Twilio returns 400 for test phone numbers). This is expected per the testing requirements.

rca_of_the_issue.original_bug: Only the first image was assigned to the withdrawal transaction
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Read-modify-write pattern caused race conditions where subsequent image additions overwrote previous ones
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed to atomic $push with $each operation (lines 3798-3804 in server.py)
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Test 04 and 08 confirm that multiple images and concurrent additions are preserved correctly
